about_the_game:
Collect all the flowers you can find and complete your collection! Some of them could even grow on concrete, while others will only thrive if you create their ideal conditions. Find information about their various quirks and gradually expand your herbarium.



Experience your garden in completely different ways at different times during the day. Some flowers go to rest at night, others only unfold in full moonlight. Lock the daytime if you only want to enjoy day or night (daylight/night mode).



Your flowers respond to weather changes in various ways. Some enjoy a fresh shower of rain, while others would rather hide under a rock.



You decide where on your screen you'd like to garden. Simply select the edges you want to play on when creating your garden. Depending on the settings, you can even move the game area a little!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
